name: East Carolina University Center for Survey Research

poll.source_locator: Release paragraph 3: 'Darline Graham leading Democratic challenger Annie Andrews by four percentage points among likely voters, 51% to 47%. Another 2% support an independent, minor-party, or write-in candidate.'
poll.notes: Undecided not reported (shares sum to 100); left null. Credibility interval +/-3.7.

pollster.weighting_quote: The data were weighted to reflect the population of likely 2026 general election voters in South Carolina based on age, education level, race/ethnicity, gender, region, and party identification, as well as election modeling based on previous statewide elections in South Carolina.
pollster.method_locator: Methodology section of the release (past-election modeling, respondent recall not stated)
pollster.mode: MMS-to-web (n=413, L2 via ReconMR), landline IVR (n=184), Bovitz online panel (n=358)
